shared_elements: multiple figures grouped in a scene
figures with raised or extended arms
justification: Both surfaces depict groups of human figures with limbs extended and some carrying implements, but that is about all they share. A shows static, frontal/profile figures with elaborate headdresses and offering stands set in strict horizontal registers with rows of signs and vessels, whereas B shows a dispersed, register-less scatter of dynamic, running and leaping silhouette figures with no framing, no objects of cult and no ordered baseline.
